notes.title: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda Update 1.09
notes.notes:
Russian language support has been added to the game.

I am happy to announce that we have overcome almost all bugs by following bug reports. 

Optimization updates were made.
The music volume has been increased slightly so that the music playing in the background can be heard better.

Fixed - When interacting with NPCs while the death counter was on, the death counter would stay on the screen.
Added - The font has been changed to support all languages spoken in the world.

notes.title: Small Update 1.07
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

 Double jump has been cancelled, you can now jump once.
 Inventory updated.

notes.title: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda Update 1.06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Added - New skill (Scythe) is used with left shift.
Added - Death counter has been added. (Death counter and inventory are opened with the B key)
Added - New main menu music.

The scythe strike requires energy and deals 1.5 times more damage than the basic attack.

[previewyoutube=z2ul5cOGJUM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Fixed - The text box would open 2 times when you jumped on the NPCs.
Fixed - When we say respawn after death, it shows 0.1 second scene from previous episodes and starts the episode.
Fixed - The order of the texts in the NPC books.
Fixed - Even if we can't buy anything in the Market spend, the sound of throwing money in the safe was heard.
Fixed - Camera would sometimes lose player focus in Eternal Sky mode.

Added - Heart replaced the spinning circle on the loading screen.

notes.title: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda Update 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Controller support has been completely removed from the game. This is because the controller causes game breaking bugs.


 The second episode has been removed from the game. Players with saves in this section should delete their game saves.
 It used to not attack when you held down the basic strike key, now it will attack once even if you hold down the basic attack key.
 A basic mechanics tutorial has been added to the first chapter.
 Boss sections will now be reached faster.
 User interfaces have been updated.

Shop prices have been updated.

 Potion reduced from 110 gold to 99 gold.
 Knife reduced from 35 gold to 25 gold.

notes.title: Small update 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Some players perceived the character's knife-throwing animation as a close-range attack. The character will no longer do the knife throwing animation unless you bought a knife from Elfo and there are no knives in your inventory.

Grocery prices have been updated.

 Potion reduced from 130 gold to 110 gold.
 Knife reduced from 50 gold to 35 gold.

notes.title: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

With this update, you can now manage and play the entire game, all menus, user interfaces, character management and selection screens with the game controller.

notes.title: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This update includes new levels, sounds, plants, themes, monsters and characters.


 New NPCs added.
 Damage taking system has been improved.
 Four new episodes have been added.
 Rain was added in the night episodes.
 New environmental sounds and music have been added.
 Added ducks that scare the main character.
 New plants and flowers have been added to all sections.
 The atmosphere of the sections where you are trapped has been turned red.
 Support character cooldown reduced.
 Potions and knives increased in price (Potion increased by 20 gold, Knife increased by 10 gold)
 Increased the spawn frequency of Ozro.
 The difficulty level of some sections has been reduced.
 Fixed an issue where the camera would explode after dying in a few episodes.
